claims.claim: Section 337(a) sets a four-year period for an action on a contract, obligation or liability founded on a written instrument.
claims.quote:
Within four years:
(a) An action upon any contract, obligation or liability founded upon an instrument in writing
claims.note: Supported for the unsecured written-contract claim in scope.

claims.claim: The four-year rule is subject to the exception in Section 336a.
Section 337 does not state when the four-year period starts for the ordinary written-contract claim in scope.
claims.quote:
Within four years:
(a) An action upon any contract, obligation or liability founded upon an instrument in writing, except as provided in Section 336a;
claims.note: Subdivision (a) gives a duration but no start date for this claim. The start-date rules in (b) and (c) concern account stated and rescission, respectively.
